name: cron_before
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname like 'ten28%' order by jobname

name: openings
sql: select status_code, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where open_home is not null) with_price from ten287_rec.openings group by 1 order by 1

name: superbet_ticks_available
sql: select e.tier, count(distinct t.event_id) events, count(*) ticks, min(t.book_updated_at) first_at, max(t.book_updated_at) last_at from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) where t.book='Superbet' and e.tier is not null and t.event_status='pending' group by 1 order by 1

name: backtest
sql: delete from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='bt1'; select ten287_bot.load_ticks('Superbet', '2026-09-25 23:00+00', now()) as loaded, ten287_bot.scan('Superbet', '2026-09-26 00:10+00', now(), 5, 'backtest', 'bt1') as alerts

name: backtest_alerts
sql: select id, tier, player_a, player_b, side_player, eval_at, ref_price, ref_at, cur_price, cur_at, pct_10m, open_price, open_at, open_kind, message from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='bt1' order by eval_at

name: backtest_by_tier
sql: select tier, count(*) from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='bt1' group by 1 order by 1

name: live_alerts_none
sql: select count(*) live_alerts from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='live'

name: bet105_bot_untouched
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot'
